reviews.text: I hired Julia's pet services sitting service to take care of my cats while I was away, and I couldn't be happier. They followed all my instructions to the letter and knowing my cats were in good hands took so much worry off my mind while I was gone. I came home to well-cared-for cats. Highly recommend for any pet parent who wants real peace of mind!

Julia’s is everything you want — respectful and caring to your pets when you can’t be available to love on them yourself.  Seeing the photos of them after a walk is a highlight — and perhaps I am jealous.  They don’t ever look that happy after a walk with me!  Flexible schedules, responsive …. They deserve every bit of the five stars.

Julia’s pet services has an entire team dedicated to caring for my pets! I used them two weekends in a row, and everything was seamless. They are super professional, and I feel very at ease leaving my pets in their care ❤️ I enjoyed them so much I gave their info to one of my best friends to use for a weekend and she was also super super happy with the service!

Julia’s Pet Service is amazing. We have been using them for over two months to pick our pups up from daycare. The team keeps us informed of the pickup and drop off time each day. We receive an update once our pups are home. The team is very flexible and accommodating if our schedule changes and we need our pups fed or crated once they are returned home. Dalton has been absolutely wonderful and our pups love him! I would recommend this team for your pet needs!
Great customer service and attention to detail. Very responsive and understanding. We have a sick dog that needs a lot of attention and meds so them having vet techs on staff is a huge benefit to us.

We had a wonderful experience with Julia's Pet Services while we were out of town for a week. They took excellent care of our cat and were consistently communicative, sending updates that gave us peace of mind about her well-being. Everything was handled professionally, and it was clear our cat was well cared for. We wouldn’t hesitate to use their services again and highly recommend them to other pet owners!

I was very happy with Julia’s Pet Services! I booked 5 days the week of Thanksgiving based on a referral from a neighbor. I appreciated the daily report with a photo & note about how he was doing. Even though he upset I was away & was usually under the bed, it was comforting to know my 13 year old baby was ok. 😻 I will absolutely use Julia’s Pet Services again!

Amazing staff and service. I received daily updates and photos from each visit with my puppies, highly recommend this company. They are extremely professional and have the sweetest pet sitters. I wish that I could give them 10 stars!
Julia’s Pet Services does a great job taking care of my cat. I always receive pictures and updates. I recommend them to anyone who is looking for care for their pets.

Julia’s Pet Service is wonderful! I leaned about this service from a friend who often travels for work.  We have an old dog who needs to be walked frequently.  The walkers are great at filling in for us and they send  updates with photos after their visits.  Great company.

Julia's Pet Service are amazing.  Very dependable, professional, and loving.  My two cats who are normally very shy warmed up to them quickly.  One cat needs insulin twice a day so it was important that their caretaker be on time and she was always there and took excellent care of both kitties.  I couldn't be happier with how things went and knowing that JPS is there will make future trips out of town much easier as I will know that the cats are in the best of hands.

The folks at Julia’s Pet Services are very dependable and conscientious, and we feel very secure leaving our fur babies in their care. They are very communicative and send reports on their visits, including cute pictures!

This group of pet sitters was fantastic! We have two dogs, and they were always punctual with walks and feedings. I had peace of mind while traveling, knowing our pets were in good hands. I would definitely recommend them!

I can’t say enough how happy we are with the care and attention Julia and her team gave Chester. Especially noticing she needed vet care, thank you tons. We loved coming home to a happy and healthy cat.
I appreciate that Julia’s pet Sitting Service followed my instructions for feeding times and placement of fresh water too,  Everyday While I out of town.

Julia’s Pet Service is the best dog care company I’ve used! They are professional and reliable always- I never have to worry about not having scheduled care for my Teddy. They send great reports after their visits and have positive attitudes. I would recommend Julia’s.
We have had a fabulous experience with our day walkers. They are dependable, personable and Maisie Mae loves them all.

This team of stellar individuals is an outstanding asset to customers in the Houston area, especially in the areas of dog walking and animal care. Their passion for animals is clear in everything they do—from the way they interact with pets to how they communicate with clients.

They are consistently reliable, showing up on time and prepared, rain or shine. Pets respond positively to their upbeat and friendly demeanor, and it's evident they genuinely care about the well-being of every animal they work with. Whether it's a quick walk or more involved care, they approach each task with responsibility and attention to detail.

Clients often share how much they appreciate the care and effort put into looking after their pets. This pet services company goes above and beyond to make sure animals feel safe, comfortable, and loved, and that peace of mind means everything to pet owners.

Their professionalism, work ethic, and natural connection with animals make them an invaluable part of the major Houston area.

Julia’s Pet Services team did a lovely job caring for my two kitties over thanksgiving break! Came home and they were clean, happy, fed, & watered. They sent pictures everyday too. Will be using them again over christmas!

I called Julia's Pet Services requesting prie information for cat visits and insulin shots for my diabetic cat. It was a last minute accommodation because my cat got sick right before my trip. Alexa was super helpful and kind to me during several stressful calls. Thankfully, my cat ended up getting better and only needing diabetic food for the time being, no insulin shots, so I did not book the service. But I am grateful for the customer service and will be booking a regular cat visit on my next trip!

I often travel for work and Julia's pet sitter team always takes such good care of my kiddos. Everyone is so sweet and attentive. The cats are happy and my apartment spotless. I would not recommend anyone else
I’ve trusted Julia’s Pet Services on two different occasions now and I could not recommend them more highly. Superb communication with me and such excellent care for my 4.5month kitten, Crossie! …
